# graviteeam_password_policy (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Password Policy

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_password_policy" "example" {
  domain_id                  = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name                       = "Strong Policy"
  min_length                 = 12
  include_numbers            = true
  include_special_characters = true
  letters_in_mixed_case      = true
  default_policy             = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this password policy belongs to
- `name` (String) The name of the password policy

### Optional

- `default_policy` (Boolean) Whether this is the default password policy for the domain
- `exclude_passwords_in_dictionary` (Boolean) Reject passwords found in common dictionaries
- `exclude_user_profile_info_in_password` (Boolean) Reject passwords containing user profile information
- `expiry_duration` (Number) Password expiry duration in seconds
- `include_numbers` (Boolean) Require at least one number
- `include_special_characters` (Boolean) Require at least one special character
- `letters_in_mixed_case` (Boolean) Require both uppercase and lowercase letters
- `max_consecutive_letters` (Number) Maximum number of consecutive identical characters
- `max_length` (Number) Maximum password length
- `min_length` (Number) Minimum password length
- `old_passwords` (Number) Number of old passwords to remember
- `password_history_enabled` (Boolean) Enable password history check

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the password policy
